issues.observation: Provider responses are captured from visible rendered DOM, not a raw inference API. Markdown can consume underscores and escape characters. Copy text returned an empty browser clipboard. Artifact failure cannot be attributed solely to model generation.
issues.action: Preserve exact captured text; do not reconstruct or manually repair it. Report end-to-end artifact acceptance separately from pure model capability.

issues.observation: Browser editor did not yield byte-exact input equality. B3 initial immediate read returned zero characters although a later DOM observation showed one submitted query; B5 editor text had a different character count. Grok B4/B6 inputs were byte-for-byte verified.
issues.action: Do not claim verified delivery parity for Gemini. Prepared material parity remains independently checked.

issues.observation: One submitted B3 user query was observed with response pending; after a second Gemini tab opened, the original temporary conversation became empty before output was captured.
issues.action: Retain the missing first attempt; retry the same frozen prompt after capturing the other Gemini batch, in one tab. Any second generation is a disclosed transport retry, outside the one-generation ideal.

issues.observation: B6 was launched before B5 while avoiding a blocked provider UI. Each provider still receives its frozen within-provider order: Gemini dxp/none/note (with the missing none delivery retried last); Grok note/dxp/none.
issues.action: Report observed timestamps; no randomized-order inference.

issues.observation: Git on Windows converted baseline line endings to CRLF. Frozen diagnostic hashes cover actual prompt source and acceptance bytes; historical baseline-protocol file checks match after CRLF-to-LF normalization.
issues.action: Allow only that line-ending normalization for the historical manifest check. Exact source edits remain byte-exact; never use fuzzy matching.

issues.observation: Installed Gemini CLI authentication loaded existing cached credentials, but Code Assist returned no existing project. No account onboarding, purchase or plan change attempted. This probe produced no inference.
issues.action: Use logged-in browser UI and preserve its limitations. Credentials never enter project files.

issues.observation: Grok arithmetic response was observed as JSON answer 95. Gemini arithmetic response was not archived; a prior progress update overstated that check. A separate Gemini code response was later observed and archived.
issues.action: Correct the progress claim; do not count the unarchived calibration as a verified result.
